name: COMO Metropolitan Singapore
positioning: Contemporary city hotel inside COMO Orchard in Singapore's Orchard Road district, with a COMO Shambhala wellness centre, Club 21 fashion and a rooftop infinity pool under one roof
best_for: Shoppers who want Orchard Road's malls and in-room personal styling on their doorstep
Wellness-minded city travelers who want sleep technology in the room and a full wellness centre in the building
Families who need a two-bedroom suite in the city

facts.text: The hotel is at 30 Bideford Road, in the heart of the Orchard Road district.
The hotel is linked to Paragon Shopping Centre via a covered walkway.
The hotel marks COMO's debut in its home country.
The hotel is part of an integrated experience spread over 19 floors at COMO Orchard, bringing together COMO's hospitality, fashion, wellness and cuisine.
The design was brought to life by Atelier Ikebuchi and Milan-based OTTO Studio headed by Paola Navone, with Norwegian digital artist Thomas Hilland and New York architecture firm Modellus Novus.
Rooms feature clean-lined, customised furnishings from Giorgetti.
Rooms include a discreet kitchenette and an in-room card-protected delivery vault for services ordered to the room.
The COMO Suite is a two-bedroom suite with a generous living and dining area and en suite bathrooms.
The thermal suites include a Red Light Therapy Room, Contrast Therapy Rooms and an Oxygen Therapy Space.
The fitness gym has over 20 types of strength and functional training equipment, including Eleiko weightlifting equipment.
Club 21 carries brands including Alaïa, Amiri, Marine Serre, Simone Rocha, Thom Browne and Tom Wood, each in dedicated spaces.
Cédric Grolet brings his signature pastries to his first patisserie in Asia here.

highlights.text: A rooftop infinity pool offers elevated views over Orchard Road.
COMO Shambhala Singapore, the wellness brand's urban flagship, occupies a 9,000-square-foot space on the fourth floor of COMO Orchard.
Every room and suite is equipped with SleepHub, a neuroscience-led device designed to help guests achieve deeper, more restorative rest.
Guests can try on the latest fashion in their own room with a Club 21 personal stylist.
The COMO Shambhala space was designed by Paola Navone of OTTO Studio to reflect the flow and palette of healing water.

considerations.text: The hotel shares the COMO Orchard building with Club 21 retail, restaurants and the COMO Shambhala wellness centre, rather than standing alone.
Singapore has no distinct wet or dry season, but higher rainfall typically occurs from November to January.
WhataHotel notes the pool area can feel limited during peak periods.
